routes.name: List Applications
routes.summary: One page of the applications the caller may see, newest first; x-next-cursor continues

purpose.description: Free text, stored encrypted. Present on the single-application view only.

decision_note.description: Free text, stored encrypted. Present on the single-application view only.

routes.name: Search Applications
routes.summary: Search the applications the caller may see; the search text is sent in the body, not the URL

jsonSchema.title: SearchRequest
jsonSchema.description:
Search text travels in the request body, never in the URL: it is often an
EIN or a person's name.

purpose.description: Free text, stored encrypted. Present on the single-application view only.

decision_note.description: Free text, stored encrypted. Present on the single-application view only.

routes.name: Create Application
routes.summary: Create a loan application; an Idempotency-Key header makes retries safe

routes.name: Get Application
routes.summary: One application with its owners (SSN last four only) and documents

purpose.description: Free text, stored encrypted. Present on the single-application view only.

decision_note.description: Free text, stored encrypted. Present on the single-application view only.

Owner.description: An owner as shown on screens: never the full SSN.

routes.name: Decide Application
routes.summary: Approve or decline; never allowed for the application's creator

routes.name: Reveal Owner SSN
routes.summary: Return one owner's full SSN; every call is written to the audit trail first

jsonSchema.title: RevealedSsn
jsonSchema.description:
The only response that carries a full SSN. Issued by the audited
reveal endpoint, one owner at a time.

routes.name: Export Application
routes.summary: Machine-readable export of one application; audited, full SSNs excluded

jsonSchema.title: ApplicationExport
jsonSchema.description: Everything held about one loan application, as machine-readable JSON.

purpose.description: Free text, stored encrypted. Present on the single-application view only.

Owner.description: An owner as shown on screens: never the full SSN.

routes.name: Sign In
routes.summary: Verify email, password and (when enabled) a two-factor code; starts a session

totp.description: Six-digit authenticator code; required once two-factor sign-in is enabled.

routes.name: Sign Out
routes.summary: End the caller's session

routes.name: Current User
routes.summary: The signed-in user

routes.name: Start Two-Factor Enrolment
routes.summary: Issue a new authenticator secret for the caller

jsonSchema.title: MfaEnrolment
jsonSchema.description:
Returned once, when enrolment starts. The secret is stored encrypted and
only becomes active after `MfaCode` confirms the authenticator works.

routes.name: Confirm Two-Factor Enrolment
routes.summary: Turn two-factor sign-in on once a code from the authenticator verifies

routes.name: Report Browser Error
routes.summary: Record an error the front end caught in the browser (class and stack frames only)

jsonSchema.title: BrowserErrorReport
jsonSchema.description:
One error the front end caught in a user's browser. It deliberately has no
field for the error message: messages can quote what a user typed.

screen.description: Screen it happened on, with record ids replaced, for example "#/applications/:id".

stack.description: Stack frames only: function, script file, line and column.

routes.name: Request Document Upload
routes.summary: Issue a grant to upload one PDF (20 MB at most) directly to object storage

jsonSchema.title: NewDocument
jsonSchema.description:
Step 1 of an upload: describe the file. The API answers with a short-lived
grant to send the bytes straight to object storage.

url.description: POST a multipart form here: every entry of `fields`, then the file as `file`.

routes.name: Complete Document Upload
routes.summary: Confirm the stored file is a PDF within the size limit and queue figure extraction

routes.name: Download Document
routes.summary: Issue a short-lived download link; the download is audited

url.description: Short-lived link to the stored PDF.
